prompt: Write a short retirement speech about a coworker named Andrea that's retiring after 24 years of service as a staff member working at Rutgers University.
response: Andrea, you've been a pillar of strength and wisdom at Rutgers for over two decades. Your dedication and expertise have been invaluable, and your impact will be felt for years to come. As you step into this new chapter, remember that your knowledge and experience will always be cherished. Congratulations on a remarkable career, and we look forward to seeing all the wonderful things you'll achieve in your retirement.
